svg.title: Native delegation is a small slice of recorded activity
svg.desc: A thin horizontal stack showing native spawn_agent calls (58) alongside the much larger exec and other tool volumes, illustrating that native delegation stays rare relative to direct action.
svg.text: Native spawn_agent is a thin slice of total recorded calls
Total recorded tool calls ≈ 116,000+. The visible sliver near the left edge is the 58 native spawn_agent calls.
Delegate* (OpenRouter-backed) work also occurred and rose sharply in August — the count here is only the native floor.
Scale is illustrative, not to exact pixel proportion. Counts show activity, not value.
